apps/shs-api/src/domain/government-assurance/service/funding-lineage-service.ts:13:  async link(actorInput: any, input: any) { const { actor: a, scope: s } = this.context(actorInput); permission(a, SHS_SECURITY_PERMISSIONS.GOVERNMENT_ASSURANCE_FUNDING_LINK); requireScope(input, s); if (!GPA_FUNDING_RELATIONSHIPS.includes(input.relationshipType as any)) throw new Error("GPA_FUNDING_RELATIONSHIP_INVALID"); if (!input.fromType || !input.fromReference || !input.toType || !input.toReference || !input.provenanceReference) throw new Error(GPA_FUNDING_CODES.FUNDING_REFERENCE_MISSING); if (["ALLOCATED", "AGGREGATED", "SHARED_COST"].includes(input.relationshipType) && !input.allocationMethodReference) throw new Error(GPA_FUNDING_CODES.ALLOCATION_METHOD_MISSING); const edges = await this.repo.listEdges(s, { reference: input.fromReference }); if (input.sourceRecordId && edges.some((edge: any) => edge.source_record_id === input.sourceRecordId && edge.from_reference === input.fromReference && edge.to_reference === input.toReference)) throw new Error(GPA_FUNDING_CODES.DUPLICATE_SOURCE_RECORD); return this.repo.createEdge({ lineage_edge_id: input.lineageEdgeId || `gpa_funding_edge_${randomUUID()}`, organization_id: s.organizationId, tenant_id: s.tenantId, from_type: input.fromType, from_reference: input.fromReference, to_type: input.toType, to_reference: input.toReference, relationship_type: input.relationshipType, amount: input.amount, currency: input.currency, allocation_method_reference: input.allocationMethodReference, period_start: input.periodStart, period_end: input.periodEnd, source_system_id: input.sourceSystemId, source_record_id: input.sourceRecordId, provenance_reference: input.provenanceReference, created_by: s.userId, metadata: input.metadata }); }
